STU-DX-001.detail: The prod profile uses sslmode {{sslmode}}; the server's certificate is not verified.
STU-DX-001.detail_unset: The prod profile sets no sslmode; the server's certificate is not verified.
STU-DX-001.remedy: Set sslmode to verify-full (or verify-ca) in the profile and give the server's CA.

STU-DX-002.detail: The profile uses sslmode {{sslmode}} for a host that is not loopback: traffic can be read or changed on the way (T-10).

STU-DX-003.detail: The profile says read_only_role, but the role, or a role it can SET ROLE to, may {{parts}}. Studio's session is read-only; the role is not.
STU-DX-003.write_one: write in {{amount}} table, view or sequence (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, a column grant or ownership)
STU-DX-003.write_other: write in {{amount}} tables, views or sequences (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, a column grant or ownership)
STU-DX-003.create_one: create tables in {{amount}} schema (CREATE on the schema)
STU-DX-003.create_other: create tables in {{amount}} schemas (CREATE on the schema)
STU-DX-003.temporary: create temporary tables (TEMP on the database)
STU-DX-003.remedy: Connect with a role that has only SELECT (and USAGE on the schemas), no CREATE on any schema, no TEMP on the database, and no membership in a role that can write.
STU-DX-003.detail_temporary: The profile says read_only_role, but the role, or a role it can SET ROLE to, may create temporary tables (TEMP on the database; PostgreSQL grants it to PUBLIC by default). Studio refuses the statements that create them and drops temporary tables when a session goes back to its pool; the role itself is not limited.
STU-DX-003.remedy_temporary: REVOKE TEMP ON DATABASE ... FROM PUBLIC (and from the role), and GRANT it to the roles that need it.

STU-DX-004.detail: Neither the role nor the database sets statement_timeout (or the most specific setting is 0), so an application that sets none runs statements without a limit (unless postgresql.conf sets one, which this role cannot read).
STU-DX-004.remedy: ALTER ROLE ... SET statement_timeout = '30s' (or ALTER DATABASE), or set it in the application (tabrion's SessionSettings does).

STU-DX-005.detail_one: PRAGMA foreign_key_check finds {{amount}} row whose foreign key points nowhere: data was written with foreign_keys off.
STU-DX-005.detail_other: PRAGMA foreign_key_check finds {{amount}} rows whose foreign key points nowhere: data was written with foreign_keys off.
STU-DX-005.remedy: Open the database with foreign_keys on (tabrion.sqlite.connect does) and repair the rows.

STU-DX-006.detail_one: The role owns, or can become the owner of, {{amount}} table or view in the database; an owner can change it and is not subject to row-level security unless FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is set.
STU-DX-006.detail_other: The role owns, or can become the owner of, {{amount}} tables or views in the database; an owner can change them and is not subject to row-level security unless FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is set.
STU-DX-006.remedy: Use an owner role for migrations and a separate runtime role for the application.
STU-DX-006.remedy_prod: Use an owner role for migrations and a separate runtime role for the application (03 section 5.4: required for prod).

STU-DX-007.detail: Default privileges (ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES) grant the role, or a role it belongs to, write access to tables or sequences created later.
STU-DX-007.remedy: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES ... REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON TABLES FROM the role.

STU-DX-008.detail_canceled: The diagnosis stopped because you canceled it. Not run: {{steps}}.
STU-DX-008.detail_time_limit: The diagnosis stopped because it reached the time limit of {{seconds}} s. Not run: {{steps}}.
STU-DX-008.remedy: Run the diagnosis again; for a large SQLite file, give the profile a longer statement timeout.

STU-DX-009.detail_definition: PRAGMA foreign_key_check failed: a foreign key definition is broken, for example it points at columns without a primary key or unique index.
STU-DX-009.remedy_definition: Fix the foreign key definitions (the parent columns need a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint).
STU-DX-009.detail_unreadable: PRAGMA foreign_key_check could not run: the database was busy, locked or not readable.
STU-DX-009.remedy_unreadable: Run the diagnosis again when no other program holds a lock on the file.

STU-DX-010.detail: Neither the role nor the database sets {{settings}}; an application that sets none runs without them (unless postgresql.conf sets them, which this role cannot read).
STU-DX-010.remedy: ALTER ROLE ... SET (or ALTER DATABASE), or set them in the application (tabrion's SessionSettings does).

STU-BK-001.detail: Studio found no SQLite file next to the database, or in its backups or backup subfolder, whose name starts with the database's name. Backups kept elsewhere are not visible to Studio.
STU-BK-001.remedy: Back the database up with tabrion.sqlite.backup (online, 0600, checked with quick_check) and keep the copy on another disk as well.

STU-BK-002.detail: The newest backup is {{span}} older than the database's last change.
STU-BK-002.remedy: Make a new backup with tabrion.sqlite.backup, for example before every migration.

STU-BK-003.detail_one: {{count}} backup file can be read by the group or by others; a backup holds all the data.
STU-BK-003.detail_other: {{count}} backup files can be read by the group or by others; a backup holds all the data.
STU-BK-003.remedy: chmod 600 the backup files; tabrion.sqlite.backup creates them with 0600.

STU-BK-004.detail: Studio could not list the database's folder or one of its backup subfolders.
STU-BK-004.remedy: Check the folder's permissions, or look for backups yourself.

STU-BK-005.detail: A folder holds more than {{limit}} entries; Studio looked at the first {{limit}} of each (in no particular order), so a backup, even the newest one, may not have been seen.
STU-BK-005.remedy: Keep backups in a backups subfolder of their own, or fewer files next to the database.

STU-BK-010.detail: archive_mode is off: the server keeps no WAL archive, so the database cannot be restored to a point in time. Studio cannot see backups made with pg_dump or with a tool that does not archive WAL.
STU-BK-010.remedy: Make sure the database is backed up (pg_dump, pg_basebackup or a backup tool); for point-in-time recovery set archive_mode and an archive_command or archive_library.

STU-BK-011.detail_one: The archiver failed {{count}} time since its statistics were reset, and the last attempt failed: the WAL archive has a gap and the server keeps WAL until archiving works again.
STU-BK-011.detail_other: The archiver failed {{count}} times since its statistics were reset, and the last attempt failed: the WAL archive has a gap and the server keeps WAL until archiving works again.
STU-BK-011.remedy: Look at the server log for the archive_command or archive_library error and fix it.

STU-BK-012.detail: archive_mode is on, but the archiver has not archived a WAL file since its statistics were reset.
STU-BK-012.remedy: Check that archive_command or archive_library is set; pg_switch_wal() forces a first file.

STU-BK-013.detail: The server is a standby with archive_mode on, which archives only on the primary.
STU-BK-013.remedy: Check the archiving on the primary, or set archive_mode = always to archive on the standby too.

STU-BK-014.detail: Studio could not read archive_mode or pg_stat_archiver with this role.
STU-BK-014.remedy: Ask the database administrator how the database is backed up.

trustCode.title: Run the project's migration code?
trustCode.body: To read the revisions, Studio imports the project's Alembic files, which runs their code on this computer, in a separate process that stops after 30 seconds. The code runs as you, as with alembic heads: it gets the open connection's address and password, so it can change the database, and it can read your files and Studio's settings. Trust it only if you would run it yourself. Studio checks alembic.ini, the revision files and the project modules in the prepend_sys_path folders, which revision files can import, and asks again when any of them changes or a module is added.

problems.connection_environment: A libpq environment variable (such as PGSERVICE) is set that could choose another server than the profile. Start Studio without it.
problems.connection_config: The driver did not accept the profile's settings. Check the profile under Connections.
problems.connection_tls: The profile's TLS mode is weaker than the host needs.
problems.connection_limit: Studio keeps at most 8 connections open. Close one first.
problems.connection_busy: The connection is busy. Try again in a moment.
problems.connection_stale: The connection was closed because its profile changed. Try again.
problems.prod_confirmation_required: This profile is marked as PROD now. Confirm the production database, then try again.
problems.connection_not_found: The connection is no longer open. Try again.
problems.database_missing: The profile's SQLite file does not exist. Check the file path in the profile under Connections.
problems.database_unsafe: The profile's SQLite file is a link or changed while it was opened. Point the profile at the database file itself, not at a link, and try again.
problems.database_outside: The profile's database file lies outside the project folder. Review the project profiles again.
problems.secret_missing: There is no password for this profile. Store it under Connections.
problems.secret_env_missing: The environment variable this profile reads its password from is not set. Set it before you start tabrion-studio, or store the password under Connections.
problems.secret_file_outside: The password file lies outside the project folder and the configuration folder.
problems.secret_file_unsafe: The password file is a link, not a regular file, has more than one name, or belongs to another user.
problems.secret_file_not_private: Other users can read the password file. Make it readable by you only (chmod 600).
problems.secret_file_unreadable: The password file is missing, empty, larger than 4 KB or not UTF-8.
problems.object_not_found: The object is no longer in the database's catalog. Refresh the catalog.
problems.explorer_engine: This information exists only for the other database engine.
problems.diagram_too_large: The schema has more than 1000 tables, more than one diagram can read. Use the tree and the Relationships tab.

db.connection: Studio could not connect. Check the host and the port (a firewall may block it), the user and the password, and the TLS mode (verify-full needs the server certificate to be trusted; verify-ca or a CA file may help).
db.auth: The database refused the sign-in. Check the user and the password.
db.timeout: The database did not answer in time. Check that the server can be reached and is not overloaded, then try again.
db.locked: The database is busy. Try again later.
db.permission: The database role has no permission for this. Ask the database owner.
db.read_only: The database refused a change: Studio connections are read-only.
db.corrupt: The file is not a SQLite database, or the database is damaged. Check that the profile's path names the database file.
db.disk_full: The database ran out of disk space. Free some disk space where the database is stored, then try again.
db.resource: The database ran out of memory or another resource. Try again later.

problems.report_invalid: Studio could not make the report: the request was not valid.
problems.report_unavailable: Studio could not read from the server the names the report leaves out, so it made no report. Try again when the connection is free, or connect again.
problems.state_unavailable: Studio's state database cannot be used, so the history and favorites are not available. Queries still run.
problems.favorites_full: You have the most favorites Studio keeps (100). Remove one first.
problems.catalog_not_loaded: The catalog of this connection is not loaded yet.
problems.script_invalid: Studio opens and saves only .sql files inside the project folder, named with plain names: no hidden folder, no device name such as NUL or COM1, no short name such as GIT~1, no name that ends in a dot.
problems.script_link: The script or a folder on its path is a link (a symbolic link, a junction, a hard-linked file or a cloud placeholder such as a OneDrive folder). Studio opens and saves only plain files in plain folders of the project.
problems.script_permission_denied: The system does not let Studio read or write this script or its folder. Check its permissions, or whether the drive is read-only.
problems.script_locked: Another program holds the script open. Close it there and save again.
problems.script_disk_full: The drive is full. Free some space and save again; the script on disk is unchanged.
problems.script_write_failed: The system refused to write the script; the script on disk is unchanged. Try again, or use Download instead.
problems.script_unreadable: The script is not UTF-8 text.
problems.script_too_large: The script is larger than Studio opens or saves (1 MB).
problems.script_exists: A script with this path exists already.
problems.script_stale: The script changed on disk since it was read.
problems.script_folder_missing: The folder does not exist. Studio creates no folders.
problems.write_profile_invalid: The write profile is not valid. It must be coupled to one of your own profiles that is not PROD and use its own role.
problems.write_profile_unknown: There is no such write or admin profile.
problems.write_profile_exists: A profile or write profile with this name exists already.
problems.write_warning_unconfirmed: Confirm the note on production credentials first.
problems.write_profiles_ignored: Write and admin profiles are used only from the configuration folder named on the command line or the platform's folder, not from one an environment variable chose. Start Studio with --config-dir for this folder.
problems.profile_coupled: A write or admin profile is coupled to this profile. Remove it first.
problems.write_prod_locked: Studio never writes to a PROD database.
problems.write_role_over_privileged: The write role is a superuser, has BYPASSRLS, REPLICATION or CREATEDB, or is a member of a server-file role (pg_read_server_files, pg_write_server_files, pg_execute_server_program). Studio does not unlock the write mode with it; use a role with only the table rights it needs. Creating databases needs an admin profile in the Database Manager.
problems.write_coupling_invalid: This write profile is not coupled to the profile of this connection.
problems.write_target_unknown: There is no open connection with this ID.
problems.unlock_name_mismatch: Type the name of the write profile exactly to unlock.
problems.write_locked: The write mode is locked. Unlock it again.
problems.write_target_changed: The profile or the database file changed; the unlock has ended.
problems.write_unsupported: Studio cannot open a write connection with its safeguards for this database.
problems.audit_unavailable: Studio could not write the audit record of this action, so it did not do it. See the audit log under write profiles.
problems.audit_record_invalid: The audit log does not take the names of this action, so Studio did not do it.
problems.plan_executor_unknown: Studio has no executor for this kind of change.
problems.plan_invalid: The requested change is missing parts, has parts that are not valid, or is too large.
problems.plan_target_invalid: A target of the change is not a table of this database. Refresh the table.
problems.plan_target_partitioned: Studio does not change partitioned tables or their partitions yet.
problems.plan_unknown: The plan expired or was replaced (a plan runs once, and a newer one can replace it). Preview the change again.
problems.plan_binding: The plan was made for another connection or an earlier unlock; preview the change again.
problems.plan_expired: The plan expired; preview the change again.
problems.plan_not_confirmed: The plan was not confirmed and was discarded; preview the change again and confirm it.
problems.plan_confirmation_mismatch: Type exactly the text the preview asks for.
problems.plan_changed: The plan no longer matches its preview and was not run; preview the change again.
problems.plan_drift: The target changed since the preview (schema, triggers, rules or the database file); nothing was run. Preview the change again.
problems.secret_unconfirmed: Studio sends this profile's secret only to a server you confirmed together with the secret's reference. Review and confirm them under write profiles.
problems.secret_confirmation_unknown: The review expired or belongs to another session. Review the server and the secret reference again.
problems.secret_confirmation_stale: The server or the secret reference changed since the review; nothing was confirmed. Review them again.
problems.secret_confirmation_mismatch: Type the server's host exactly as shown.
problems.secret_confirmation_not_needed: A SQLite write profile has no secret.
problems.secret_confirmation_unavailable: Studio could not keep the confirmation in its state folder; nothing was confirmed.
problems.write_tls_required: Studio sends a write or admin secret to a server that is not on this computer only with TLS mode verify-full or verify-ca. Change the TLS mode of the coupled profile.
problems.require_auth_unavailable: Write and admin connections need libpq 16 or newer (it can refuse clear-text and MD5 passwords). Install psycopg[binary] or a newer libpq.
problems.plan_target_no_primary_key: The table has no primary key, so Studio cannot edit its rows.
problems.data_editor_conflict: A row was changed or deleted by someone else since it was loaded. Nothing was saved. Reload the rows and try again.
problems.data_editor_rowcount: A change did not affect exactly one row. Nothing was saved.
problems.data_editor_value_invalid: A value does not fit its column, or a required value is missing. Nothing was saved; the cells in question are marked.
problems.data_editor_constraint: The database refused a change because it breaks a rule of the table (a unique value, a reference, NOT NULL or a check). Nothing was saved: all changes were rolled back. The change in question is marked.
problems.data_editor_column_incomparable: A column of this table has a type that cannot be compared (for example xml or point), so a change by someone else could not be detected. Studio does not edit this table at all, whichever columns are shown; edit it with another tool.
problems.schema_create_invalid: A field of the new database is missing or not valid; the field says what. Nothing was created.
problems.schema_create_unconfirmed: To create the database, type its name exactly as shown. Nothing was created.
problems.schema_create_engine: A PostgreSQL database is created on an unlocked PostgreSQL connection of the same server.
problems.schema_file_exists: A file or link with this name, or one of its side files (-wal, -shm, -journal), exists already. Studio never overwrites a file; choose another name.
problems.schema_folder_unsafe: Studio does not create the file in this folder: it does not exist, is or goes through a link, belongs to another user, or others may write to it or to a folder above it. Choose a folder of your own by its real path.
problems.schema_folder_reserved: Studio does not create databases in its own configuration, state, audit or log folders or in the project's .tabrion folder. Choose another folder.
problems.schema_create_platform: On Windows Studio does not create SQLite files yet. Create the file with another tool and add it as a connection profile.
problems.schema_database_exists: The server has a database with this name already. Choose another name.
problems.schema_createdb_required: The admin profile's role may not create databases (CREATEDB) on this server. Nothing was created.
problems.schema_owner_missing: The server has no role with the owner's name. Nothing was created.
problems.schema_owner_not_allowed: The admin profile's role may not act as the owner role, so it cannot give it the database. Leave the owner empty or ask the administrator.
problems.schema_draft_missing: There is no draft for this connection (not started, discarded, or its unlock ended). Start a draft again.
problems.schema_draft_stale: The draft changed since this page read it, for example in another tab. The page shows it again; make the edit again.
problems.schema_draft_schema: This schema cannot be designed: on SQLite only main, on PostgreSQL a schema that exists and is not one of PostgreSQL's own.
problems.schema_draft_limit: The draft would exceed a limit of the Schema Designer (tables, columns, constraints and indexes, edits or size). Nothing was changed.
problems.schema_edit_invalid: The edit is not valid. The draft was not changed.
problems.schema_plan_refused: Tabrion refuses to plan this change. There is no way around the refusal; leave that table unchanged or use your own migration tooling.
problems.schema_model_invalid: Tabrion cannot make the change as designed. Check the type, the texts and the names.
problems.schema_run_not_allowed: Studio does not run this plan directly (the reason is below). Nothing was changed.
problems.schema_backup_required: This plan needs a backup before it runs. The backup can be left out on DEV only.
problems.schema_backup_failed: The backup before the run could not be made, so nothing was run. Check the free space and the backup folder.
problems.schema_run_check_failed: A check before the commit failed (see below). The run was rolled back; nothing was changed.
problems.schema_run_outcome_unknown: It is not known whether the run was committed (the connection broke at the commit). Check the database before anything else.
problems.schema_run_failed: The run failed and was rolled back; nothing was changed.
problems.schema_compare_invalid: A side of the comparison is missing or not valid. At most one side can be a snapshot file.
problems.schema_compare_schema: This schema cannot be compared: main on SQLite, and on PostgreSQL a schema that exists, that the profile can see and that is not one of PostgreSQL's own.
problems.schema_snapshot_invalid: The file is not a level-2 schema snapshot that Tabrion can read. Nothing of it was used.
problems.schema_snapshot_too_large: A side is larger than the comparison's limits (2 MiB of snapshot text, 500 tables, 250 columns or 100 constraints and indexes per table).
problems.schema_compare_mismatch: The two sides cannot be compared: they are of different database engines or snapshot levels.
problems.schema_compare_plan_not_allowed: No plan preview for these sides. The comparison is shown.
problems.schema_revision_not_allowed: No revision was written (the reason is below). Nothing was changed.
problems.schema_revision_invalid: The revision message is 1 to 200 characters on one line, without control characters.
problems.schema_revision_head_unknown: Studio could not read exactly one head of the project's revisions (several heads, none, or code that is not trusted). Nothing was written.
problems.schema_revision_folder: The revision folder (versions under the script_location) must be a folder inside the project, reached without a link. Nothing was written.
problems.schema_revision_exists: A file of the new revision's name exists already; Studio never overwrites a file. Preview again.
problems.schema_revision_failed: The revision file could not be written. Check that the revision folder is writable.
problems.profile_export_invalid: The profiles or the file of the export are missing or not valid; the field says what. Nothing was written.
problems.profile_export_unconfirmed: Type the new file's name exactly as shown to export. Nothing was written.
problems.profile_export_multi_host: A profile that names several hosts cannot be exported: the profile file holds one host per profile, and Studio never shortens the list. Leave this profile out. Nothing was written.
problems.profile_export_folder: Studio does not write the export into this folder: it does not exist, is or goes through a link, belongs to another user, or others may write to it or to a folder above it. Choose a folder of your own by its real path.
problems.profile_export_reserved: Studio does not write exports into its own configuration, state, audit or log folders or the project's .tabrion folder. Choose another folder.
problems.profile_export_exists: A file or link with this name exists already. Studio never overwrites a file; choose another name.
problems.profile_export_platform: On Windows Studio does not write profile exports yet: it cannot check who may write the folder. Nothing was written.
problems.profile_export_failed: The export file could not be written. Check the free space and the folder, then try again.
problems.backup_tool_unavailable: pg_dump or pg_restore is not usable. Studio runs them only from the absolute paths in database-tools.toml next to its write settings: a program of the expected name, owned by you or root, not writable by others, not a link, version 16 or newer and at least as new as the server.
problems.backup_tool_failed: pg_dump or pg_restore ended with an error or ran out of time. A backup that did not finish was removed, and nothing that depends on it was done.
problems.dbm_backup_failed: The backup could not be written to Studio's backup folder, so nothing that depends on it was done. Check the free space.
problems.dbm_backup_unknown: Studio restores only backups from its own backup folder. Choose a backup from the list.
problems.dbm_backup_invalid: The backup or its description does not match (changed, not private, a link, another format or another kind of database). Nothing was restored.
problems.dbm_restore_not_allowed: Studio restores only into a DEV or TEST target or a new one, never into what a PROD profile names, and on PostgreSQL only into a new database. Nothing was restored.
problems.dbm_restore_name_invalid: The name is empty, too long, has blanks at either end or holds characters that cannot be seen. A new SQLite file ends in .db, .sqlite or .sqlite3.
problems.dbm_restore_name_mismatch: The typed name does not match the target's name exactly. Nothing was restored.
problems.dbm_restore_role_unsafe: A PostgreSQL restore runs as a separate restore profile whose role has none of SUPERUSER, BYPASSRLS, REPLICATION, CREATEROLE or CREATEDB and no predefined role. Nothing was restored.
problems.dbm_restore_target_exists: A database or file of this name exists already. Choose a new name. Nothing was restored.
problems.dbm_restore_target_changed: The target is no longer the one that was checked. Nothing more was done; look at the target and start again.
problems.dbm_restore_failed: The restore could not be done. A PostgreSQL restore runs in one transaction, so the new database stays empty; it is left for you to inspect or drop.
problems.dbm_delete_not_allowed: Studio deletes only a DEV or TEST database: never a maintenance or template database, never the one the admin connection uses, never what a PROD profile names, and a SQLite file only in a safe folder of your own and not on Windows. Nothing was deleted.
problems.dbm_delete_name_invalid: The database name is empty, too long, has blanks at either end or holds characters that cannot be seen. Nothing was deleted.
problems.dbm_delete_name_mismatch: The typed name does not match the target's name exactly. Nothing was deleted.
problems.dbm_delete_target_missing: No database of this name exists on the server. Nothing was deleted.
problems.dbm_delete_target_changed: The target is no longer the database or file that was checked and backed up. Nothing was deleted.
problems.dbm_delete_in_use: Other sessions or programs use the database. Studio did not end them and nothing was deleted.
problems.dbm_delete_backup_unverified: The backup made before the delete could not be verified (for example, the schema changed while it was made), so nothing was deleted. Try again when nothing changes the schema.
problems.dbm_delete_failed: The database could not be deleted. Its backup from before the delete is kept in the backup folder.
problems.admin_over_privileged: The admin role has or reaches SUPERUSER, BYPASSRLS, REPLICATION, a server-file role, or CREATEROLE before PostgreSQL 16. The unlock ended; use a leaner admin role.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.hint: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to run, Esc to close

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.lead: These shortcuts work everywhere in Studio. The command palette lists every command.
help.caption: Keyboard shortcuts
help.later: The SQL editor's shortcuts work on its page. In the editor, ⌘/ or Ctrl+/ comments lines out; the header button opens this help there.

shortcuts.nextRegion: Go to the next area (header, navigation, tabs, main area or its panes, status bar)
shortcuts.run: Run the statement at the cursor or the selection (SQL editor)
shortcuts.runScript: Run every statement of the tab (SQL editor)
shortcuts.cancel: Cancel the running query (SQL editor; also Escape in the results)
shortcuts.save: Save the tab as a .sql script in the project (SQL editor)
shortcuts.explorerFilter: Focus the explorer filter (on the Explorer page)
shortcuts.format: Format the selection or the whole statement text (SQL editor)

editor.title: SQL editor
editor.noProfile: Choose a connection profile for this tab first.
editor.noStatement: There is no statement at the cursor or in the selection.
editor.shortcuts: {{run}} runs the statement at the cursor or the selection, {{script}} runs every statement, {{cancel}} cancels. Tab leaves the editor.
editor.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Select the value in the detail panel and copy it there.

problem.range: :{{name}} is too large for a number. Give it as text and cast it, for example :{{name}}::bigint.

result.title: Results
result.empty: Run a statement to see its result here. Studio runs only reading statements.
result.cappedRows_one: {{rows}} row, capped at {{rows}} (more rows exist) · {{ms}} ms
result.cappedRows_other: {{rows}} rows, capped at {{rows}} (more rows exist) · {{ms}} ms
result.cappedBytes_one: {{rows}} row, capped at the size limit of a result (more rows exist) · {{ms}} ms
result.cappedBytes_other: {{rows}} rows, capped at the size limit of a result (more rows exist) · {{ms}} ms

detail.title: {{column}}, row {{row}}
detail.cut: The server cut this value (64 KB of text, 32 KB of bytes); the rest is not loaded.

problems.readOnly: This connection is read-only. The database refused the change (read-only transaction).
problems.refused: Studio runs only reading statements: SELECT, WITH, VALUES, TABLE, EXPLAIN of a query, SHOW and SQLite's PRAGMA.
problems.multiple: Studio runs one statement at a time. Run the statements one by one or use Run script.
problems.transaction: Studio runs every statement in its own read-only transaction; BEGIN, COMMIT, SET and similar statements are refused.
problems.gone: This result is no longer kept on the server (Studio keeps the last 16). Run the statement again.
problems.limit: Studio runs at most 4 queries at a time, 2 per connection. Wait for one to finish or cancel one.
problems.paramsInvalid: A parameter value is not valid. Give JSON as text and cast it, for example :doc::jsonb.
problems.tooLarge: The statement or its parameters are too large.
problems.timeout: The statement ran longer than the profile's time limit.
problems.syntax: The database could not parse the statement.
problems.undefinedObject: A table, column, function or other object does not exist.
problems.permission: The database role may not read this object.
problems.data: A value does not fit its column or operation.

editor.profileChanged: The profile {{name}} changed since this page read it (now {{environment}}). Nothing was run on it; run again to use it as it is now.
editor.reconnectFirst: You disconnected {{name}}. Nothing was run. Choose “Reconnect” above; then the query runs.
editor.profileGone: The profile {{name}} no longer exists. Nothing was run.
editor.environmentUnknown: The server did not say which environment the connection to {{name}} is in, so it was closed again. Nothing was run.
editor.formatFailed: The statement could not be formatted (it may be incomplete). Nothing was changed.

completion.loadHint: Read the tables and views of this PROD database for completion
completion.loaded: Table and view names loaded for completion.

scripts.openBody: The .sql scripts in the project folder. The script opens in a new tab and does not run.
scripts.unavailable: The scripts could not be listed.
scripts.none: The project folder has no .sql scripts yet.
scripts.more: Not every script is shown. Narrow the filter to find the others.
scripts.skippedLinks_one: {{count}} link was left out: Studio opens no script through a link or a cloud placeholder folder.
scripts.skippedLinks_other: {{count}} links were left out: Studio opens no script through a link or a cloud placeholder folder.
scripts.skippedInvalid_one: {{count}} file or folder was left out: Studio does not open its name (a device name, a name ending in a dot, an invisible character). Rename it to open it.
scripts.skippedInvalid_other: {{count}} files or folders were left out: Studio does not open their names (a device name, a name ending in a dot, an invisible character). Rename them to open them.
scripts.alreadyOpen: {{path}} is already open: this is its tab.
scripts.saveBody: Save the tab as a .sql script in the project folder. Studio creates no folders.
scripts.pathHint: Relative to the project folder, with / between folders, ending in .sql. Example: sql/report.sql
scripts.pathInvalid: Use a relative path ending in .sql, without .., names starting or ending with a dot, device names such as NUL or COM1, or short names such as GIT~1.
scripts.staleBody: {{path}} changed on disk since this tab read it. Overwriting replaces those changes with the tab's text.
scripts.existsBody: {{path}} already exists. Overwriting replaces it with the tab's text.

viewer.limited: Pages here hold at most {{rows}} rows, so that a page of the widest values stays within the browser’s memory limit.
viewer.cutByBytes: This page stopped at the result size limit; “Next” shows the rest.

search.label: Search this page
search.matches_one: {{count}} of {{total}} rows on this page match.
search.matches_other: {{count}} of {{total}} rows on this page match.

status.rowsLast: Rows {{first}}–{{last}}; this is the last page.

hint.no_primary_key: No primary key: the rows are paged by their physical position (rowid or ctid), which is not stable when the table changes.
hint.unstable_order: No primary key: the rows are paged by position, so their order may change between pages.

filter.title: Filters
filter.chooseColumn: Choose a column for every filter.
filter.tooLong: These filters are too long for one request. Shorten their values or use fewer filters.
filter.caseSqlite: All filters must hold. “contains” and “starts with” ignore the case of ASCII letters on SQLite.
filter.casePostgres: All filters must hold. “contains” and “starts with” respect case on PostgreSQL.

full.done: The whole value is shown ({{size}} bytes).
full.cut: The first 10 MB of the value are shown (it has {{size}} bytes).
full.unavailable: Rows of a view without a primary key cannot be found again, so the whole value cannot be loaded here. Open it with a query in the SQL editor.

problems.viewer_column_unknown: The object has no column with this name anymore. Refresh the catalog.
problems.viewer_filter_too_long: These filters are too long for one request. Shorten their values or use fewer filters.
problems.viewer_sort_unsupported: This column cannot be sorted (its type has no order, for example json, xml or a geometric type). Sort by another column.
problems.viewer_page_unknown: Studio no longer keeps this page. Start again at the first page.
problems.viewer_cell_unavailable: The whole value cannot be loaded for this row. Open it with a query in the SQL editor.
problems.viewer_row_gone: The row is no longer there, or it changed. Reload the page.
problems.query_limit: Studio is already running as many queries as it allows, in all or on this connection. Wait for one to finish.

export.title: Export
export.description: Export {{subject}} as a file. The export only reads.
export.fetched_one: The fetched row of the result ({{rows}})
export.fetched_other: The fetched rows of the result ({{rows}})
export.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
export.escape: Protect against spreadsheet formulas (a text that starts with =, +, - or @ gets a leading ')
export.again: Studio runs the statement again for the export, read-only, so the file holds the rows as they are now.
export.cappedFetched: The result was cut, so this export stops at the same number of rows. Choose "Up to" to export more.
export.csvCut: If there are more rows than the limit, the file stops there; a CSV file does not say so.
export.jsonCut: If there are more rows than the limit, the file stops there and says so.
export.canceled: The export was canceled; nothing was saved.
export.doneCut: Export saved: {{filename}} ({{size}}). It stops at {{rows}} rows; more rows exist.

problems.invalid: The export settings are not valid: a format and 1 to 1 000 000 rows.
problems.busy: Another export is running on this connection, or two are running already. Wait until one has finished.
problems.stopped: The export took longer than 10 minutes and was stopped. Export fewer rows, or filter the query.
problems.incomplete: The file did not arrive whole, so nothing was saved. Try again.
problems.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}}, too large to assemble in the browser, so the export was stopped and nothing was saved. Export fewer rows or columns.
problems.connectionGone: The connection is no longer open. Run the statement again, then export.

connectionLost.title: Connection lost: {{name}}
connectionLost.disconnected: You disconnected this connection. Studio connects again only when you choose “Reconnect”.
connectionLost.database: The database does not answer. Studio reads nothing more on this connection until you reconnect.
connectionLost.stale: The profile was changed, removed or is no longer trusted, so Studio closed the connection.
connectionLost.closed: Studio no longer has this connection; it was closed.
connectionLost.nothingLost: Nothing was lost: Studio only reads.

history.title: Query history
history.lead: The statements you ran in the SQL editor, newest first. Studio keeps the statement and the names of its parameters, never their values. Nothing here runs by itself.
history.empty: No statement ran yet. Run one in the SQL editor and it shows here.
history.off: The history is off: new statements are not kept.
history.truncated: Only the first 64 KB of this statement were kept.
history.deleteBody: The statements are removed from Studio's state database and cannot be restored. Your databases and scripts are not changed.
history.deleteAllBody: This deletes the statements of this project's profiles and of your own profiles. Your own profiles are shared by every project, so their statements leave the history of your other projects too. They cannot be restored; your databases and scripts are not changed.
history.truncatedTab: This statement was cut: the history kept only its first 64 KB.

vectors.title: Vector data
vectors.lead: Shows what a database holds for vector search: vector columns and their types, vector indexes, embedding dimensions and models, how many embeddings are stored, and whether pgvector or sqlite-vec is installed. It only reads; nothing is embedded, indexed or changed.
vectors.noProfiles: There is no connection profile yet. Add one under Connections.

restore.done: Restored into {{target}}. Studio could not confirm that its schema matches the backup; check it.
restore.preBackup: The target was backed up first as {{file}}.

delete.title: Delete a database
delete.leadPostgres: Delete another DEV or TEST database of this server by its name. Never the maintenance databases and never the database this connection uses. Look at the delete first; that changes nothing.
delete.leadSqlite: Delete this connection's own database file. Look at the delete first; that changes nothing.
delete.warningPostgres: {{name}} is deleted for good. Studio makes a verified backup first and deletes nothing if that fails. Studio's own connections to it are closed.
delete.warningSqlite: The file {{name}} and its journal files are deleted for good. Studio makes a verified backup first and deletes nothing if that fails. Studio's connections to the file are closed, and with them this unlock.
delete.sessions_one: {{count}} other session uses this database now.
delete.sessions_other: {{count}} other sessions use this database now.
delete.forceUnavailable: Ending other sessions needs PostgreSQL 13 or later. Close them outside Studio first.
delete.force: End the other sessions on this database (FORCE)
delete.forceType: Type {{name}} once more to end the other sessions
delete.done: {{target}} was deleted. Its backup from before the delete is {{file}}.
